explanations: remaining is computed as deadlineAt - startedAt, which always equals budgetMs and never shrinks as chunks upload. Each chunk therefore gets min(budget, 15s) regardless of elapsed time, so a sync of many slow chunks can run far beyond the client's deadline; the overrun is only noticed at commit (where Date.now() is used correctly), after all the work has been done. It should be deadlineAt - Date.now().

Every chunk is still hashed and pushed onto `chunks` before the existing.has check, then skipped. commitFile is always called with the full chunk list. No putChunk calls happen; the commit is not skipped; the list is not empty.

withTimeout only converts errors into DeadlineExceededError when the signal was aborted. A network error with no abort is rethrown unchanged, and handleSync rethrows anything that is not a DeadlineExceededError. There is no skip or retry logic.
handleSync clamps with Math.min(clientDeadlineMs, MAX_BUDGET_MS), giving 300000. 60000 is only the default when none is given, and 15000 is the per-chunk cap, not the budget.
